I've hit the tool ceiling for this turn, so here's where things stand before I author anything. Nothing has been delivered yet — say continue and I'll produce the tar.gz.

The tree, verified
Reconstructed from dump.txt at commit 759fd56: 363 records, 361 hash-matching on the first pass, the two exceptions being export.sh (it contains the delimiter, so its own SHA can't reconcile) and LICENSE (elided by design). The last record needed the dump footer stripped, after which it hashed to a378f35… exactly as stated. Working tree is trustworthy.

0007_menu_item_image_alt_text.sql is already committed — the dump's git status shows only docs/llm/vendor/claude-output.txt modified, so the git add I flagged last session was done.

The build break, diagnosed
TableOrderSurface.razor:248 is @{ int headingIndex = -1; }, and it sits inside the else { code block opened at line 199. Razor is already in C# there, so @{ is a transition out of a context it was never in — RZ1010. The fix is one line: drop the transition and write the bare statement.

The three other @{ sites in the tree are all legal and I checked each one: KitchenBoard.razor:257 inside <section>, TableOrderSurface.razor:642 inside <li>, AdministrationMenu.razor:167 inside <div class="menu-group-body">. Each has an element as its nearest enclosing construct; line 248 has a C# block. That difference is the whole finding, and it is not decidable from text without a Razor parser — so my ruling is that the compiler is the gate and no shadow parser goes into the suite. Writing a second, worse Razor parser to catch a class the real one catches in three seconds is F-59's mechanism with extra steps. F-104 will record that, and record what the verification checklist could not see: brace balance and tag-tree walks have no notion of transition context.

The menu increment
The tree names it itself. §16.4 currently says:

There is deliberately no IMenuItemImageEventLog … the reader arrives with the surface that renders it, exactly as IMenuSectionEventLog arrived with the section editor.

So Stage 4d — the picture's history, and it is the closest-precedent slice available: MenuSectionEventLog.cs is the template line for line, menu_item_image_event already carries all four types with alt_text_changed written since 0007, and ManageMenuItem.razor already has a .record-list history table to sit beside. Planned files: the new reader, one line in OrdersServiceCollectionExtensions, the panel plus a DescribePicture switch on ManageMenuItem.razor, a new MenuItemImageEventLogTests (6 facts, mirroring the section reader's six plus the one only this table has — the history outliving the row a removal deletes), and one wiring fact.

Test arithmetic: 1242 → 1249. Six new integration facts, one wiring fact. MenuWiringTests 27 → 28, counted-class floor 28 → 29 with the new class cited in §16.4. data-label parity holds — three new <td>, three new labels in the same file.

One thing I want to flag before authoring rather than after: I'm deferring browser downscaling a fifth time. The plan calls it the thing that decides whether pictures are usable at all, and it is unverifiable here — no browser, and swapping a file into a DataTransfer before a static-SSR POST is exactly the shape that looks right and silently posts nothing. It wants a session where you can watch it work. Veto me if you'd rather have that than the history panel.
